title: Model labs, version 1
description: The labs that make catalogued models, keyed by lab ID. A lab ID is the `vendor` value on facts.json cards.

id.description: The lab ID, equal to its key.

name.description: Display name, as the lab writes it.

logo.description: The lab's official logo, copied unchanged from a first-party source. Logos are trademarks of their owners and are not covered by this repository's license.

path.description: The logo file, relative to labs.json.

kind.description: symbol: the mark alone; wordmark: the name alone; lockup: mark and name together.

source_url.description: Where the artwork was obtained: the asset's URL, or the first-party page it was extracted from.

guidelines_url.description: The lab's brand or logo usage guidelines, when it publishes them.

retrieved.description: The day the artwork was obtained.
